scope: three corrected-PDP configurations x three dense training seeds
metric: rho_i = abs(a_(f_i,k_i)^H m_i) / (norm_2(a_(f_i,k_i)) * norm_2(m_i)); m_i is row i of extract-after-dft_like, a_(f_i,k_i) is the CP-DFT atom of its selected data RE
metric_notes: Phase-invariant complex inner-product magnitude; not a mean-subtracted Pearson correlation.
